capabilities.description: Use the actual Rotini studio to pin generator inputs, originate one exact current collection, and publish PNG, animated GIF, and offline interactive ZIP projects; recover only from its durable checkpoint without another signer or pin write.
Use an independent collector through the actual Rotini mint UI to reserve immutable seeds, render and pin every supported output, and finalize three directly viewable FA2 tokens.
